# The cases need separate paths to the same result: recovery Discard of a never-sent folder, including one with its own rules and a create in flight; a purged folder after a rename or restart; and a merged create on a disk that holds one spelling versus a disk that holds two. Existing remote-delete tests start with a server trash node and cannot distinguish these paths.
# The driver owns the scan after Discard and the actual move into local trash. The engine-only tests cannot verify that a never-sent folder and its rules file reach trash together after the last excluded entry is removed.
